platform_context: r/dubairealestate thread: Buying UAE investment property as a resident Indian?
raw_text: Hi everyone — I'm trying to understand how Indian residents can legally purchase higher-value property in Dubai or Abu Dhabi under the LRS/FEMA rules. My parents are Indian citizens, tax residents of India, and live in India full-time. They are not NRIs and they do not already have significant funds held outside India. My understanding is that under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS), each resident individual can remit up to USD 250,000 per financial year outside India, including for the purchase of overseas property. So I'm trying to understand what happens if they want to buy a property significantly above that amount.
